d:
Paranprik churma laddu banane ka aasan tarika. suji besan vale ye churma laddu jyada supar sopht,danedar hain. sath hi ghar par hi bura (tagar) banane ka pura tarika bhi diya gaya hai. aata churma laddu chahe tyauharon ke liye banayen ya rojana khane ke lie. ye laddu bahut hi svadisht hote aur inki shelph laiph bhi mava laddu ki apeksha adhik hai.
Aapke sabhi savalon ka hal bhi ki
Churma laddu ke lie aata kaise gunthen?
Churma laddu ke lie bura kaise banaen?
Churma laddu tutte kyon hain?
Churma laddu bandhne ki sahi vidhi
Churma laddu ko danedar kaise banaen?
